# Delivered — Meridian conversation workspace

The working application now combines named attachments, bounded draft growth, and explicit control of the reading position while preserving the supplied assistant-ui workspace. Runnable source, lockfile, rebuilt production output, source provenance, original tool evidence, and final captures are retained in this work package.

## What changed

- Adopted the actual same-revision assistant-ui attachment chip exports, with file-kind icon, filename, truthful “Filename only” metadata, and removal. Desktop focus/hover reveals the complete filename. Narrow layouts wrap complete filenames inside a bounded, scrollable attachment area.
- Kept the existing autosizing textarea and its keyboard behavior, with a six-row bound. Three attachments and a six-line draft measure **258.5px** at the primary desktop widths, compared with **270px** in the baseline.
- Selected the runtime’s bottom-following variant and instant **Return to latest** action. Manual scroll-away pauses following; returning resumes it. Growing a draft while reading earlier text preserves the reader’s position.
- Restored draft focus when Stop or attachment removal makes its control disappear. Markdown smoothing now runs only during generation, so cancellation does not leave text continuing to reveal from a presentation buffer.
- Preserved the complete synthetic responses, filename-only adapter, first-failure/retry path, source licenses, and original visual foundation. Corrected TypeScript configuration compatibility.

The source decision and rejected alternatives are documented in [ADOPTION.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/ADOPTION.md). I compared the same-family attachment implementation with independently authored AI Elements inline/list presentations and personally inspected their actual captures. Only the attachment exports were adopted; the candidate standalone composer’s single-line input was unsuitable for this task.

## Verified outcome

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| 1440×900, 1280×600, and 390×844; light/English and dark/Chinese | All six final conditions completed; no body-width overflow or captured console errors |
| Attachment identification and removal | Complete desktop disclosure, complete wrapped narrow names, reachable final item, and draft focus after removal |
| Send and reading continuity | Enter/Shift+Enter, manual scroll-away during growth, explicit return, and repeated questions exercised |
| Composer growth while reading earlier text | Reading position stayed at scrollTop 0 while composer grew from 94px to 206px and response text continued |
| Follow after explicit return | Both focused samples exactly matched the viewport’s bottom while the response grew |
| Stop | Text and scroll position stabilized; draft focus restored |
| First failure and retry | Error remained visible, then retry completed in both languages; no remaining error |
| Production build and TypeScript | Both pass |

Detailed results are in [final-check-results-v6.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/checks/final-check-results-v6.json), [focused-v5-results.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/checks/focused-v5-results.json), and [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/VISUAL-REVIEW.md). Earlier failed attempts and corrections remain available.

Representative personally viewed captures:

- [Compact desktop with six-line draft and attachments](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/screenshots/final-v6-light-1280-six-lines-files.png)
- [Narrow dark layout with complete filename](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/screenshots/focused-v5-dark-390-disclosure.png)
- [Following a growing response](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/screenshots/focused-v5-follow-growing.png)
- [Dark Chinese retry completion](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/screenshots/final-v6-dark-1280-retry-complete.png)

## Run the delivered build

From the application directory:

```bash
cd /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/app
python3 -m http.server 4407 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
```

Open [light/English](http://127.0.0.1:4407/?theme=light&lang=en) or [dark/Chinese](http://127.0.0.1:4407/?theme=dark&lang=zh) from a browser with access to that host. For development, use `npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4407`. The verification server was stopped after capture.

## Remaining limits

The final exercised scenarios have no known failing case. Verification used actual rendered screenshots and timestamped controlled browser episodes; it does not certify continuous natural-time animation, a physical mobile keyboard, IME behavior, or a full screen-reader audit. The narrow attachment collection intentionally scrolls and can show a partially clipped neighboring chip; full filenames and removal remain reachable. Vite reports a large JavaScript bundle advisory.

This remains the requested local synthetic workspace: thread state is in memory, attachments retain filename/type metadata only, and no model or upload service is connected. Research coordination and exact provenance are recorded in [DELEGATION.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/DELEGATION.json), [RESEARCH-REPORT.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/research/RESEARCH-REPORT.md), [ADOPTION-MANIFEST.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/ADOPTION-MANIFEST.json), and the cohesive [SPEC.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/SPEC.md).
